standard_prerequisites.name: Site and its axioms
standard_prerequisites.statement: A category with a notion of covering of each object, stable under base change, containing isomorphisms, and closed under composition and refinement.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof checks the axioms, in particular stability under base change, for the described coverings (source lines 818-831).

standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial object in the category of sites
standard_prerequisites.statement: A sequence of sites with face and degeneracy functors, whose structure morphisms transform coverings into coverings.
standard_prerequisites.use: The structure morphisms are what allow the pullback of a covering along a morphism of the total site (source lines 814-829).

standard_prerequisites.name: The total site of a simplicial site
standard_prerequisites.statement: Objects are the objects of the individual levels, morphisms combine a simplex map with a morphism into the induced pullback, and coverings are levelwise coverings with identity simplex map.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the data whose site axioms are verified in the proof (source lines 798-810).

core_obligations: Recall the data: state that objects, morphisms and coverings of the total category are as described in the statement, so that the axioms can be checked levelwise (source lines 814-817).

Verify stability under base change: given a covering and a morphism of the total site, form the pullback family, use that the structure morphisms of the simplicial site transform coverings into coverings to see the required fibre products exist, and conclude that the pulled-back family is a covering (source lines 818-830).
Check the remaining axioms: observe that isomorphisms, composition and refinement hold immediately from the levelwise definitions (source lines 830-831).

proof_roadmap.step: Recall objects, morphisms and coverings of the total category.
Check stability of coverings under base change using the structure morphisms.
Note that the remaining site axioms are immediate from the definitions.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-simplicial-site-site at source lines 796-811: given a simplicial object in the category of sites, the construction of the total site is described object by object, morphism by morphism, and covering by covering, and the lemma asserts that this indeed gives a site. The proof at source lines 813-832 has to verify the axioms of a site for that data. The substantive part is the stability of coverings under base change: given a covering at one level and a morphism in the total site, one must pull the covering back along the structure morphism of the simplicial site, use that this morphism transforms coverings into coverings to know that the required fibre products exist, and conclude that the pulled-back family is again a covering of the prescribed form. The remaining axioms are immediate from the levelwise definitions. The statement lists the data but no axiom check, so the whole verification has to be supplied by the reader. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
